description: Agent loop settings shared by all three agents. Each agent's name and its own instructions are
in its folder's instructions.json (mcp/, pydantic/, vercel/).
max_tool_calls: the most tool calls the model may make while answering one prompt;
0 means no limit (a model stuck in a loop then runs until stopped with Ctrl+C).
A multi-step task (read a project, change it, build, open a pull request) needs 20 or more.
memory_index: the agents' memory index (relative to the repository), loaded into their
instructions at start-up; the memory tool maintains it.
save_on_exit: when the user types exit in the interactive chat, first give the model one
turn to save what is worth remembering (the on_exit prompt in instructions.json); skipped
for a session with no tool call and a single exchange, and by Ctrl+C or a --prompt run.
skills_dir: the skills folder (relative to the repository): one <name>/SKILL.md per skill, whose
name and description are listed in the agents' instructions at start-up; the skill tool reads them.
